scope: Additional authorized independent zero-reset audit of immutable first full minimum-clearance v1 result; no controller-prefix diagnosis or measurement/gate changes

verification.process_hash_caveat: Original episode report and reset ledger do not pin new process receipt hashes. This audit inventories their current bytes and validates status/error, but cannot compare their hashes with an independent original pin.
verification.artifact_evidence_list: episode-report.rows in stored order; each row pins episode bytes, its episode pins raw bytes, and sibling .process.json is rehashed
verification.episode_raw_process_list_serialization: sha256(json.dumps([[row.file,sha256(episode bytes),episode.raw_trace_file,sha256(raw bytes),sibling_process_file,sha256(process bytes)] for row in episode-report.rows], sort_keys=True).encode())
verification.process_sorted_list_serialization: sha256(json.dumps([[file.name,sha256(file bytes)] for file in sorted(run.glob('*.process.json'))], sort_keys=True).encode())
verification.source_copy_list_serialization: sha256(json.dumps([[copy.file,sha256(copied bytes)] for copy in protocol.source_copies], sort_keys=True).encode())

independent_method.primary_inputs: Frozen protocol, source copies, episode report,48 episode JSON files and48 raw JSONL files; old baseline24 episode/raw pairs
independent_method.calculation: Separately implemented physical encounter start/rear-clear brackets, continuous station crossings, station+-25 interpolated XY endpoints, world chord path length, clipped held-action steering coverage/integral, sustained centerline return and whole-episode hits directly over raw JSON
independent_method.comparison_tolerance: Numeric derived fields compared with rel_tol1e-11/abs_tol1e-10; recorded actions/world/contact values compared exactly
independent_method.live_source_drift: Main began separately sourced r2 after immutable v1 result completion. Live controller/packager bytes are not v1 evidence and were not required to match. All frozen v1 copies match protocol pins. The live-code-sensitive load_run was not used or bypassed.
independent_method.units: Native geometry meters, steering normalized command, integral in command-seconds, simulation lap seconds; internal proxies only

old_new_baseline_parity.clearance_note: New measurement handles inside-polygon clearance as signed distance, unlike the old implementation. This audit did not require raw byte equality or all-controller metadata equality. No sampled baseline clearance value differed in this cohort despite the changed interior formula.
old_new_baseline_parity.velocity_limit: Raw receipts store scalar speed, not vx/vy or angular velocity. Scalar speed/yaw/acceleration and XY finite-difference motion match exactly; hidden Box2D solver/velocity-state identity is not claimed.
old_new_baseline_parity.old_original_crossing_zip_caveat: Baseline is immutable source reconstruction, not restoration of missing original crossing ZIP4447c8dfad1392ddbbb83f0b3d23b8d5237af2b9be785cdfd08edaf6c4623f64 or historical missing primary report.

completion_and_safety.interpretation: Safety nonregression does not mean collision-free driving or certified continuous-time physical safety. Completed-passage clearance excludes two incomplete contact encounters, which remain in the144-object safety inventory.

eligibility.seam_caveat: All18 windows for the3 layouts on seed38300 are initially beyond entry; excluded from fixed-window path/return inference, not from completed physical passage clearance or whole-episode safety.

aggregation_notes: Clearance mean is equal-weight mean of138 per-obstacle bracketed physical-passage MINIMA, not sample-weighted mean clearance. The latter is separately reported with1601/1603 raw sample denominators.

Path/lateral/steering table means equally weight119 matched windows. Adoption instead weights21 per-cell mean fractional path changes equally; the119-window mean difference is not that gate statistic.
Steering mean is mean of per-window time-weighted absolute command; maximum is maximum observed executed command across these windows; integrals are exact clipped held-action command-seconds.
The full baseline finished-lap set and kept candidate set both contain21 cells. Three DNF lap times are null; no artificial24-episode mean or expected completion time is assigned.
These21 path cells and21 kept lap cells are different sets, with overlap18. The eight consumed geometry seeds and their track-specific layouts are dependent, not24 independent roads.

path_and_lap_gate_arithmetic.note: Two geometries have tiny negative fractional path means, neither reaches the predeclared2% threshold. No path/lap improvement gate passes; no significance or sub-tick timing claim.

sustained_centerline_return.definition_unchanged: After first all-fixture rear-clear sample, abs centerline lateral<=1m for>=0.24s continuously, confirmation by fixed station+25 exit; time is onset minus rear-clear
sustained_centerline_return.censor_note: The single paired both-returned difference is descriptive with n1, not the144-object cohort mean, not a recovery improvement.118 window-exit censors per arm and their observation lower bounds remain in immutable result.arm_summaries.return_observations; no-return inside this short fixed window is not no eventual return.

actual_intervention.interpretation: Sparse real steering intervention, not successful recovery evidence. Full reason/projection counts are observed state labels only; no guard-horizon mechanism diagnosis or counterfactual safety proof was duplicated.

conclusion: V1 preserves the recorded finish/safety/window denominator gates but does not shorten the avoidance path or lap under its predeclared contract. No adoption, fresh-road generalization or official performance follows; main separately assesses any source-bound r2 correction.
